pictures.scene: Cornelis Droochsloot, Dorpsstraat - the village street with the church tower standing over it and the thatched houses lining the road, the two women in white caps talking in the foreground and the man in the tall hat with his dog, the villagers seated at their doors and the great grey cloud filling the sky above, a song of ascents, when the LORD restored the captives of Zion we were like dreamers
pictures.name: pd_droochsloot_dorp

pictures.scene: Nikolai Bogdanov-Belsky, Children's Choir - the crowd of peasant children packed shoulder to shoulder singing from the dark song books held open before them, their mouths open and their faces lit warm gold from below, the girls in red and green and blue patterned headscarves and the fair haired boy singing at the back, then our mouths were filled with laughter and our tongues with shouts of joy, then it was said among the nations, the LORD has done great things for them
pictures.name: pd_belsky_zingen

pictures.scene: Joaquin Sorolla, La vuelta de la pesca - the fisherman in the broad straw hat standing at the tiller of the boat while the great white sail swells above him and the yoked oxen wade through the shining surf to haul the boat ashore, the far sails lying on the bright horizon, the LORD has done great things for us, we are filled with joy, restore our captives O LORD like streams in the Negev
pictures.name: pd_sorolla_vreugde

pictures.scene: Alexey Venetsianov, In the Ploughed Field, Spring - the barefoot woman in the red headdress and the long pink sarafan walking out over the bare brown field leading the horses with the harrow behind them, the wide pale sky standing over the empty ground, those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy, he who goes out weeping
pictures.name: pd_venetsianov_zaaien

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, The Harvest - the great stack of sheaves with the ladder leaning against it and the man in blue working beside it, the gold plain running out to the farm buildings and the cart and horses, the blue hills along the far edge under the pale green sky, bearing a trail of seed he will surely return with shouts of joy carrying sheaves of grain
pictures.name: pd_gogh_schoven

lines.text: When the LORD restored the captives of Zion,
Then our mouths were filled with laughter,
our tongues with shouts of joy.
Then it was said among the nations,
“The LORD has done great things for them.”
The LORD has done great things for us;
will reap with shouts of joy.
will surely return with shouts of joy,
